text_block_list.text:
I run into Кинг Хало one morning as I'm
heading
to the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One more time... I'll check with my
camera just
one last time...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I'm hideous! My face... My skin is
so dull
and lifeless!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Y-you really think so? I-I think you look
as cute
as always...
text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't you use a camera
filter to
brighten yourself up a bit?
text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
No! Unacceptable! There will be no
compromise!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Natural beauty shines through even
without a
filter! My regal brilliance
cannot be allowed to
fade!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Starting today, I'm reevaluating my daily
routine,
diet included. And you two will
be joining me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало appears to be having some
issues with
her complexion...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
